newsitem.title: USA: Minn Gov. signs $21 mln flood relief package.
newsitem.headline: Minn Gov. signs $21 mln flood relief package.

text.p: Minnesota Gov. Arne Carlson on Tuesday signed a $21 million flood relief package using funds from the state budget reserve.
The money will be used to reimburse local governments and to provide grants and local matching funds for individuals for flood costs, according to a news release from Carlson's office.
The law also allows state agencies to suspend rules temporarily to speed flood recovery efforts and to waive fees in counties under a disaster declaration.

School districts that lost students to other districts because of the flooding will not lose state aid under the new law and the districts that have accommodated them will receive an appropriation as well.
